buildingInputCandidates: Candidate documents · not yet assigned evidence
buildingInputNoCandidate: No document with a matching type. Untyped files may still contain the evidence.
buildingInputAddress: A unique German state needs a matching saved address or location. Ambiguous, stale or conflicting metadata cannot be used.
buildingInputPlanning: Use the saved site assessment or read an assigned development plan. Missing register results do not establish §34; plan zones and applicability still need checking.
buildingInputEdition: The state narrows reference editions, not their applicability. The project's permit date, transitional provisions and cited assessment are needed to choose an edition.
buildingInputAgreement: The agreed acoustic target must come from the specification, contract or assessment. Minimum protection is not an automatic project default.
buildingInputAcousticMethod: A specialist must establish whether the standard method covers this building and exposure. Address and noise data alone do not establish applicability.
buildingInputFlanking: Flanking needs an assessment of junctions and connected constructions. Missing junction data does not mean negligible transmission.
buildingInputDescription: Read construction descriptions in Sound insulation after assigning component roles. That reader supports construction, material, thickness and density; conflicting or unassigned statements remain open.
buildingInputDimensions: Use assigned dimensions, a calibrated plan or an element schedule. Page boxes, unscaled geometry and missing openings cannot supply a reliable quantity.
buildingInputClearHeight: Needs the finished floor-to-ceiling height assigned to this storey or room. Floor-to-floor, ridge and fire heights are different; the 3D preview height is not evidence.
buildingInputAssembly: Needs the exact layer build-up, installation or product specification. Material name and wall thickness alone do not identify these details.
buildingInputAcousticProof: Needs a test certificate, supported catalogue calculation or cited acoustic proof assigned to this element. A required rating is not its achieved performance.
buildingInputCatalogue: Choose a configured catalogue entry matching the actual construction. A similar description is not proof of a matching build-up.
buildingInputTopology: Use accepted geometry, IFC declarations and reviewed room connections. Derive from plan proposes roles; drawings and colours alone do not confirm them.
buildingInputRoomUse: Use the room schedule, plan label and unit assignment. Label-based suggestions remain provisional; an unknown room is not automatically a dwelling or sleeping room.
buildingInputConfirmation: This is an explicit completeness or execution check. Imported records cannot confirm that nothing is missing or that installation conditions were met.
buildingInputFireHeight: Read section heights in Fire protection. Transfer needs the highest habitable floor relative to mean terrain, with known units and references; ridge height is not a substitute.
buildingInputUnits: Needs a complete dwelling and non-residential unit schedule. Detected apartment labels are only a partial count; missing other units must not become zero.
buildingInputAreas: Needs an area schedule with the correct legal basis and building/unit assignment. Room areas, BGF and usable areas are not interchangeable; an absent garage is not a proven zero area.
buildingInputFireUse: Needs the building's actual use, configuration and approved fire strategy. Zoning and room labels alone cannot establish this classification.
buildingInputSmokeVent: Needs the stairwell's ventilation design: opening location, operation and applicable requirements. A window on a plan does not prove smoke ventilation.
buildingInputRescueWindow: Needs the unobstructed clear passage with the sash open, sill height above finished floor and evidence that the window is easy to open from inside. Rough-opening or acoustic dimensions and smoke ventilation never substitute for these checks.
buildingRescueLimits: Unreviewed comparison against the recorded RP rule. Not proof of a second escape route or ladder access; the applicable edition and roof access still need review.
buildingRescueThresholds: RP § 37(2), sentence 1: clear width ≥ 0.90 m, clear height ≥ 1.20 m, sill ≤ 1.20 m; easy to open from inside.
buildingRescueNext: Provide missing clear dimensions and opening details from window drawings or manufacturer data. Roof windows also need a separate rescue assessment.
buildingRescue_not_met: At least one criterion not met
buildingRescue_unsupported: This state's rule is not supported
buildingRescue_not_designated: Not designated as a rescue window
buildingInputLoadBearing: Needs structural plans or a structural designer's statement. Wall thickness or construction material cannot establish load-bearing function.
buildingInputFireProof: Needs the specific assembly/door approval, classification or fire strategy. The required fire rating must not be copied as the achieved rating.
buildingInputFullStorey: Needs a section-based assessment under the applicable state law. Storey names and the number of drawn floors do not establish Vollgeschoss status.
buildingInputParcel: Use the official parcel area saved in Feasibility or a cadastral source. A design envelope or estimated polygon is not the legal parcel area.
buildingInputFootprint: Needs the building footprint under the zoning counting rules. Summed room areas or the maximum buildable envelope are not the actual footprint.
buildingInputLevel: Use the source plan's storey title or an explicit level assignment. PDF page order is not a floor number.
buildingModelCoverageNoPlan: No page met the automatic floor-plan threshold. No geometry was guessed; all pages remain available for review.
buildingModelCoveragePlansQueued: Detected floor-plan pages were queued for unreviewed draft geometry. Other pages remain classified or unresolved as listed.
buildingRegulatorySuggestionsHint: Suggestions are references, not a determination of applicability. You can enter another edition or the exact source wording. Selection does not approve a value.
buildingHeightUnreviewed: Inferred · unreviewed. Using a height does not approve it. Review the source and property separately.
buildingHeightNoSections: No eligible section or elevation pages were found.
buildingHeightAlreadySet: This building already has a fire height. It will not be overwritten.
buildingHeightNoObservations: No supported height observations on this page.
buildingHeightNoRooms: No eligible saved room in this plan set. Accept and assign its geometry first; incompatible construction states cannot receive this dimension.
buildingHeightRoomScope: Inspect the section endpoints and the room's source plan, building and storey. This dimension must actually apply to this room—not an adjacent section or merely another room on the same storey. Unknown labels or construction state remain pending professional review.
buildingHeightRoomConfirm: I checked the source dimension and its endpoints and confirm that it applies to this selected room. This is not an extrapolation or professional approval.
buildingHeightRoomExists: This room already has a clear-height property. No value will be replaced, including rejected, cleared or conflicting values.
buildingHeightCopied: Height copied as inferred and unreviewed. Property approval is a separate step.
buildingVolumeGroundReference: Translucent surface: assumed ground at level 0, not surveyed terrain. Negative levels sit below it.
buildingVolumeGroundUnknown: Schematic ground at scene zero, not surveyed terrain. Floor levels are incomplete; page order does not establish basements.
buildingVolumeViewOnly: Display only. Hidden floors do not take up stack space; model records and calculations stay unchanged.
buildingVolumePlacementDetails: Floors retain their shared metric sheet coordinates; registration between drawings is not verified. Floors use entered levels, otherwise plan order; spacing uses room heights plus an assumed 0.30 m floor allowance. These preview assumptions are not saved or used in calculations.
buildingVolumeWallReview: Wall footprint from the plan; height inherited from the storey. Review its outline, phase and exterior/interior role in 2D. The enclosure is not verified as complete.
buildingVolumeDisclaimer: Plan-based building preview. Missing heights use 2.60 m. Geometry, topology and compliance still require review.
buildingPresentationSiteUnaligned: Real surroundings require a saved, source-matched site alignment. This model is not placed on a guessed address.
buildingPresentationSiteSources: Site sources · overlapping context buildings are hidden in this presentation only. Tree detections remain unreviewed.
buildingPresentationAerialUnavailable: Aerial imagery is unavailable. Building geometry remains accessible.
buildingPresentationLegend: Illustrative preview · finishes, furniture and roof caps assumed · drag to orbit
buildingPresentationDetails: Traced wall gaps receive illustrative infill: 1.40 m glazing with a 0.90 m sill, or a 2.10 m door where a swing was traced. Unclassified gaps are not confirmed windows. Canonical openings take precedence. Slabs and horizontal roof caps follow available outlines, not verified roof pitches. Finishes and furniture are illustrative, never engineering inputs. Source geometry hides these additions.
buildingPresentationCounts: {placed} placed model openings · {infill} provisional infills · {rooms} furnished rooms
buildingVolumeNoGeometry: These rooms have no usable outline, or their matched room is already shown. Review the selected outline in 2D; label anchors are not room geometry.
buildingVolumeNoRooms: No rooms or room drafts on this source page and construction state. Select a floor-plan page or check extraction in Plan context.
buildingVolumeNoScale: Room outlines are available, but this page has no metric scale. Set the plan scale to show their volumes.
buildingVolumeDraftReview: Extracted outline—not approved geometry, construction phase or topology. Accepting it creates a canonical room; height assumptions still need separate confirmation.
buildingVolumeMatch: This draft may match an existing room. Review the match in 2D to avoid creating a duplicate.
buildingVolumeDraftHeight: This draft uses the storey height or the unsaved 2.60 m preview default. Accept its outline before saving a room override, or edit the storey default now.
buildingVolumeUnavailable: 3D is unavailable in this browser. Dimensions can still be edited here.
buildingVolumePrevious: Previously reviewed: {value} m. The new draft does not replace that review.
buildingVolumeSelectRoom: Select a room to edit its height.
buildingConnectionDisclaimer: Review geometric connections only. This does not approve fire resistance, sound insulation or escape routes.
buildingConnectionDeriveHint: Uses accepted room and wall outlines across the model. Also proposes wall roles, thicknesses, openings and ceilings. Keeps reviewed connections.
buildingConnectionDraft: Accept room and wall outlines in the 2D plan before deriving canonical connections. A preview outline is not a confirmed boundary.
buildingConnectionNoBoundaries: No active wall boundaries for this room. Enclosure is unresolved.
buildingConnectionMissingSide: Wall side {side} is unresolved. It is not assumed to face outside.
buildingConnectionAmbiguousHost: Several active wall hosts. The opening's host is ambiguous.
buildingConnectionMissingHost: No active wall host for this opening.
buildingConnectionEmpty: No stored connections. Select an object or derive from accepted outlines.
buildingConnectionAlignmentGap: Connections do not yet establish a closed shell or align floors. Floor placement remains schematic.
buildingCalculationHint: Calculate this page with all non-demolished accepted geometry and usable candidates, independently of the display filter. Nothing is accepted or approved.
buildingCalculationCounts: {used} candidates included · {excluded} excluded or already reviewed
buildingCalculationLimits: Conditional results, not compliance. Missing specifications stay missing; no height or material is invented. Exterior noise needs site and facade inputs. Whole-building and cross-storey checks remain separate.
buildingCalculationFire: Fire checks: {complete} evaluated · {open} blocked or unsupported. Evaluated does not mean compliant.
buildingCalculationSound: Interior sound: {count} wall calculations without input gaps.
plannerPlanChooseHint: This project has several PDFs. Choose the drawing you want to inspect; the 3D view will not combine it with other documents. This is a view selection, not approval for calculations.
plannerPlanSuperseded: Replaced plan set · available for source inspection only
plannerPlanPreparationHint: Preparation is running or needs attention. Check its status before reviewing the extracted geometry.
plannerPlanScaleHint: This page has no usable metric scale. Check the printed scale or choose a scaled floor-plan page before using dimensions.
plannerPlanReviewHint: Compare rooms, walls and openings with the original drawing.
plannerPlanViewOnly: View selection · not an engineering approval
plannerPlanScope: Only the selected document is shown in 3D. Automatic extraction and project-wide assessments are unchanged; selecting a view does not approve or replace any source.
buildingTaskMove: Move task window: drag or use arrow keys; Shift for larger steps
buildingTaskDockLabel: Dock task panel in right sidebar
buildingTaskNoNeeds: No model review needs listed in this scope. This does not establish completeness.
buildingTaskNoSaved: No open saved tasks for this discipline across project phases.
buildingTaskSavedStale: Showing the last loaded tasks; refresh failed.
buildingTaskScope: Review needs for the selected PDF and construction state; not a complete assessment.
buildingTaskNoEvidence: No source evidence saved for this value. Link the supporting source before treating it as verified.
buildingBatchExplain: Percentage of five recorded geometry checks passed, not a calibrated probability. Room-use confidence does not qualify geometry. Conflicts and unsupported objects stay excluded, even at a low threshold.
buildingBatchEligible: {count} room outlines eligible; {excluded} excluded; another {unscored} objects without a supported score.
buildingBatchLimits: Only room identity and outline are adopted into the draft. Room use, measurements, areas and engineering approval remain separate.
buildingBatchConfirm: I have checked the preview and want to adopt these room outlines into the draft.
buildingBatchStale: The model or selection changed. Refresh the preview before adopting.
buildingBatchDone: {count} room outlines adopted into the draft.
buildingBatchChecks: Five checks: enclosed boundary, unambiguous label, shape plausibility, printed-scale area comparison and page-local area consistency. Each contributes 20 points; missing checks contribute zero. Walls are not scored yet.
buildingTaskOutlineHint: Compare the room boundary with the original plan.
buildingTaskAreaConflictHint: Check the boundary, area convention and scale against the plan.
buildingTaskOutlineMissingHint: Only the label was found. Draw the outline or select an enclosed area.
buildingTaskBoundaryReviewHint: Which areas belong together? Compare the boundary with the plan.
buildingTaskCorrectedHint: Compare the correction with the original plan, then adopt it.
buildingTaskNoteHint: Give a reason to leave this open
buildingTaskDecisionCounts: {unchanged} adopted unchanged · {corrected} adopted corrected · {matched} reconciled · {rejected} rejected · {deferred} left open
buildingTaskDecisionLimits: Latest saved individual decisions for this plan. Not an independent reference review or measured accuracy.
